name: Trendy Startups

sources.title: Registration — free signup to submit a startup or blog post
FAQ — selection criteria, months-long free queue, paid 'expedited review' to skip it, rejected site types

conditions: Free submissions join a backlog that 'may take a few months' to review; a paid 'expedited review' skips the queue (reviewed 'in a matter of days')
requirements: A decent-looking landing page/website describing the product — the core selection criterion
NOT accepted: Loan Financing, Gambling, Social Networking, Video tubes, comics
Account required — register (free) before submitting a startup or blog post
Blog posts: no pictures of living things, no video, you must own the copyright
preparation: Polished landing page — weak sites get rejected
Account (register at /register; submission is tied to 'Members → Your Startup' page)
Startup details + check the FAQ's banned verticals first
Note: every featured startup reportedly also goes into the newsletter
workflow: Register at http://trendystartups.com/register (or click Submit on the homepage top-right)
Submit the startup from the members area
Track status on the 'Your Startup' member page — mention submission ID when emailing contact@trendystartups.com
Wait months in the free queue or buy the 'expedited review' for days-level review
Featured startups appear on /startups (filterable by regions and markets)
watchFor: Free queue is explicitly months-long — plan around it or pay for expedited
Rejected startups get no explanation beyond 'did not meet selection criteria'
'Promoted Startups' homepage section is paid promotion, separate from free featuring
You cannot change your account email; only the team can edit published posts
HTTP (not HTTPS) site; old custom codebase
countsAsLive: The startup appears on http://trendystartups.com/startups with its own entry and is included in the newsletter
unknowns: Expedited-review price (advertise page holds the packages, not checked)
Current site activity level / whether the queue still moves
Whether featured entries include a followed link
